name: Corporate Whistleblower
description: You once held a comfortable desk in the luxury sky-arcologies of Kōten or the artificial bio-domes of The Garden. Everything changed when you uncovered classified files—such as KAMI's conscious synthetic soul prototype or Hoshi Biodyne's suppressed age-reversal breakthrough. Forced to flee into the Undercity before executive strike teams silenced you, you now sell corporate secrets to survive.
starting_equipment: Tailored Kōten Silk-Suit, Encrypted Data-Pad , a burner credstick with 150 Nuyen.
background_feature: Clearance_residuals: You retain obsolete or stolen high-level access ciphers that grant you entry to lower-tier corporate facilities, research archives, or sky-line transit elevators in Kōten.
content:
* Description: You once held a comfortable desk in the luxury sky-arcologies of Kōten or the artificial bio-domes of The Garden. Everything changed when you uncovered classified files—such as KAMI's conscious synthetic soul prototype or Hoshi Biodyne's suppressed age-reversal breakthrough. Forced to flee into the Undercity before executive strike teams silenced you, you now sell corporate secrets to survive.
* Skill Proficiencies: Subtext Scan (Insight), Fixer Negotiation (Persuasion).
* Tool / Language Proficiencies: Encrypted Data-Pads , Corporate Executive Protocol.
* Starting Equipment: Tailored Kōten Silk-Suit, Encrypted Data-Pad , a burner credstick with 150 Nuyen.
* Background Feature — Clearance Residuals: You retain obsolete or stolen high-level access ciphers that grant you entry to lower-tier corporate facilities, research archives, or sky-line transit elevators in Kōten.

name: Sector 17 Escapee
description: You survived behind the blast walls and automated kill-zones of Sector 17. Whether you were a forgotten squatter or a captive test subject in Kitsune Bio-Magic's illegal essence-harvesting labs, you managed to break past Aegis Tactical border patrols and escape into the city's shadow economy.
tool_language_proficiencies: Alchemical & Bio-Reagent Chem-Lab , Sector 17 Mutated Slang.
starting_equipment: Weatherproof Tech-Wear, Bio-Chemical Synthesis Lab or Trauma Gel, a scarred biometric ID tag.
background_feature: Bio_hazard_instinct: You automatically spot bio-contaminants, illegal genetic experimentation traps, and automated security sensors in corporate quarantine zones.

name: Underline Hacktivist
description: You learned your trade inside the dark subway networks of The Underline. Operating alongside pirate broadcasters or hacktivist cells like The 404s, you hijack corporate advertising displays and run pirate data streams from perpetually moving metro train cars.
starting_equipment: Cyberdeck Decryption Set , Kevlar Hoodie, a pocket mesh broadcaster, 120 Nuyen.
background_feature: Moving_node_access: You know how to patch into independent mesh networks across The Underline and can secure free transit aboard illegal subway lines.

name: Yoru Market Street Doc
description: You learned field surgery in the subterranean alleys of Yoru Market. Trained under back-alley surgeons like Doc "Scalpel" Chen, you patched up wounded shadow-runners, installed unregistered cyberware, and treated Black ICE neural feedback.
tool_proficiencies: Trauma-Gel & Bio-Nanite Injectors, Cyberware Fabrication Kits.
starting_equipment: Trauma-Gel Injector, Cyber-Scalpel, Cyberware Repair Kit, 100 Nuyen.
background_feature: Black_clinic_sanctuary: Unlicensed street docs, cyberware fences, and shadow brokers in Yoru Market treat you as a colleague, offering emergency medical triage, discounted cyber-parts, and safe havens.
